policy: Promote recovered runtime winners after validating them on the current implementation. A modest Snakes regression is acceptable for a worthwhile Sky Force gain. Keep mutually exclusive implementations separate until their current comparison is complete. Current-runtime promotion work is in progress; the unfinished historical reassessment remains resumable.

state-pruning.note: Full ARM and Thumb load/store pruning

quiet-runtime-cuts.note: Verifier-disabled trusted dispatch omits unused work

ram-hit-inline.note: Compact dispatch already inlines the trusted hit and removes its old metadata pointer chase

guard-publication-omission.note: Integrated in quiet-runtime cuts for trusted execution

compiled-syscalls.note: Restore and measure on the current runtime; Sky Force tradeoff authorized

compiled-syscalls-long-snakes.note: Additional Snakes route for the same syscall change

sparse-rom-lookup.note: Restore and compare with today's inlined ROM registry

entry-only-pruning.note: Normal entries are already pruned; compare omitting private-fallback pruning against current full pruning

whole-entry-budget.note: Alternative to outlined-entry-budget; retain one compatible winner

outlined-entry-budget.note: Alternative to whole-entry-budget; retain one compatible winner

batched-counts.note: Restore generic batching and measure with current direct memory
